candidate.title: TSCS
candidate.scope: The middle TSCS row of the assigned Illumina schematic: Topographic single-cell sequencing of genomic DNA from individually imaged and laser-catapulted cells in frozen tissue sections, through DOP-PCR and cell-barcoded DNA libraries to spatially associated genomic readout. The supplied Casasent et al. full text resolves the implementation as sparse single-cell genome sequencing for copy-number profiling. The four drawn collection/terminal tracks are represented as four anonymous per-cell instances A–D; the enlarged single-tube library-preparation inset is repeated for those cells. The left Single cell → DNA with spatial info pair summarizes the assay rather than adding another extraction route. Neighboring CRISPR-UMI and OS-Seq rows, separate exome experiments, and unshown adaptations are outside this scope. DOP-PCR/SNS is an embedded amplification component, not another target method.
